rationale: The workflow is a Go CI job that runs on every push and PR to master, with no existing dependency cache. The repository has go.mod/go.sum files (root and examples), so repeated dependency fetching occurs on each run. Evidence record experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9 (pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE) measured adding actions/cache for the Go module cache after checkout and before build/install steps, with key based on runner.os and hashFiles of go.mod/go.sum, reporting 6.06% elapsed savings with all tests still passing. Preconditions are met: repeated dependency fetching is measurable and cache inputs include the lockfile. No contraindications apply: no equivalent cache exists and the module cache is trusted, content-addressed content. The change adds one cache step after checkout and before the build steps, preserving all matrix jobs, build steps, and test coverage exactly as-is. No permissions are weakened and no new network access, secrets, or deployment operations are introduced.
